description: Every valid filter value with the number of records carrying it: jurisdiction and regulator codes with their full names, content types, topics, sectors, firm types, urgency levels and deadline types. CALL THIS FIRST if you are unsure of any filter value. Values are exact and case-sensitive — "uk" not "UK", "AML / Financial Crime" not "AML" — and a wrong value returns zero results rather than an error, which is indistinguishable from the data genuinely being empty.
name: regmonitoring_get_taxonomy
title: Get filter values
